mapper.select: SELECT d.attendance_device_id, d.company_id, c.company_name, d.device_name FROM attendance_device d JOIN company c ON c.company_id = d.company_id WHERE d.device_key_hash = #{keyHash} AND d.use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT d.attendance_device_id, d.company_id, c.company_name, d.device_name FROM attendance_device d JOIN company c ON c.company_id = d.company_id WHERE d.company_id = #{companyId} AND d.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY d.attendance_device_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN MAX(ends_at) <= THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM service_period WHERE company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT de.device_user_no, e.employee_id, e.employee_name, dp.department_name, e.employment_status FROM device_employee de JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = de.employee_id AND e.company_id = de.company_id LEFT JOIN department dp ON dp.department_id = e.department_id WHERE de.attendance_device_id = #{attendanceDeviceId} AND de.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY de.device_user_no

SELECT de.device_user_no, e.employee_id, e.employee_name, dp.department_name, e.employment_status FROM device_employee de JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = de.employee_id AND e.company_id = de.company_id LEFT JOIN department dp ON dp.department_id = e.department_id WHERE de.attendance_device_id = #{attendanceDeviceId} AND de.device_user_no = #{deviceUserNo} AND de.use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT FROM attendance WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date >= TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND work_date < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1) ORDER BY work_date

SELECT TO_CHAR(holiday_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS holiday_date, holiday_name FROM holiday WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND holiday_date >= TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND holiday_date < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1)
